name: ISO 16750-4:2023 clause 5.1 constant-temperature tests of automotive E/E components: low-temperature storage (-40 C, 24 h, unpowered), low-temperature operation (Tmin, 24 h, powered) and high-temperature storage (85 C, 48 h)
plain_name: Leave a car electronic unit at -40 C for a day, then at 85 C for two days
description: Constant-temperature climatic tests for road-vehicle electrical/electronic equipment per ISO 16750-4:2023: storage at -40 C for 24 h (IEC 60068-2-1 Test Ab, operating mode 1.1), operation at Tmin for 24 h with the DUT powered (Test Ab/Ad, operating mode 3.3 or 4.3; Tmin = -40 C for code C) and dry-heat storage at 85 C for 48 h (IEC 60068-2-2 Test Bb).
keywords: Leave a car electronic unit at -40 C for a day, then at 85 C for two days

sources.citation: ISO 16750-4:2023, Road vehicles - Environmental conditions and testing for electrical and electronic equipment - Part 4: Climatic loads, 4th ed., ISO (preview pages via iTeh Standards)

requirements.rationale: Low-temperature storage is performed at -40 C (233.15 K) for 24 h.
High-temperature storage is performed at 85 C (358.15 K) for 48 h.
The low-temperature operation test runs the DUT electrically (operating mode 3.3/4.3) at Tmin for 24 h, so supply and signal wiring to the DUT inside the chamber is required.
